lessons.friction: The prototype occupied more than a gigabyte because full-resolution PNG frame caches sat beside the reusable source.
lessons.rootCause: Disposable renders and reusable Format files had no explicit boundary.
lessons.smallestFix: Keep content-hashed resumable frames inside ignored run directories and exclude all run state from the downloadable kit.
lessons.evidence: The source can resume interrupted captures, while KIT-MANIFEST.json contains no agent-runs or frame cache paths.

lessons.scope: covered by existing Wiggly rules 7 and 9
lessons.friction: The original renderer contained event-specific slide art and facts.
lessons.rootCause: The first polished proof blurred Format mechanics with story content.
lessons.smallestFix: Move all facts, display copy, timing slots, story images, and pronunciation overrides into a validated content pack.
lessons.evidence: We The Artists and Wiggly Format Lab render through the same runtime without event facts in runtime/renderer/app.js.

lessons.friction: The second proof clipped a longer monitor eyebrow even though it passed the original character-count validation.
lessons.rootCause: Character limits did not account for font metrics and per-layout width.
lessons.smallestFix: Measure every variable monitor string in the renderer and reduce font size to the layout's declared minimum when needed.
lessons.evidence: The first Wiggly Format Lab contact sheet exposed the clipping; attempt two and the smoke contact sheet show the same copy fitted inside the monitor.

lessons.friction: The second narration provider output was 39.72 seconds for a fixed 30-second composition.
lessons.rootCause: Narration duration varies even when the prompt requests a particular delivery speed.
lessons.smallestFix: Probe the actual audio, tempo-fit speech to 29.1 seconds, and preserve an explicit final hold.
lessons.evidence: Inspection reports a 30.000-second output and a final silence hold of 0.885 seconds.

lessons.friction: A blind agent completed the Repo but had to infer that dependency installation precedes the SKILL's smoke command and that media should open in the host viewer.
lessons.rootCause: README contained both facts, but the agent-facing ordered loop did not state them at the exact point of use.
lessons.smallestFix: Put npm install before smoke and name the host viewer directly in the agent loop; clarify that Fish variables are optional when approved audio ships with an example.
lessons.evidence: The blind run completed on attempt one with zero provider calls; its state, quality report, and finalization receipt are preserved under evidence/blind-handoff.

sharedStandardChange: None. The cross-Format lessons are already represented by proven Wiggly rules 6, 7, and 9; the remaining fixes are specific to this video Format.
